general_information.Description: This course equips students with knowledge about car structures, including knowledge related to the structure and operating principles of cars. This knowledge will help students understand cars and be helpful in their future work in programming car systems. The module content also introduces software applications in the automotive industry. In addition, the module also equips students with career orientation, soft skills as well as professional ethical foundation, customer care and initial experiences with cars.
general_information.StudentTasks: Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Constantly follow announcements on LMS at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information regarding assignment submission and feedback on assignments and project work.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand the basic structures of vehicles (explain the basic components and functions of the main systems in vehicles).
Describe in detail the structure and operating principles of the main systems
Understand the global electric vehicle market and development trends
Understand and describe the role of software applications in the automotive industry
Be able to simulate basic vehicle systems and evaluate performance metrics
Understand and apply legal standards and requirements related to automobiles
Be able to develop essential soft skills, including teamwork, communication, and problem-solving
